title: Beyond Free-Form Generation: Measuring Interface Composition in Competitive NLP Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.29103v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Systems with decoder LLMs can combine free generation with scoring, ranking, or selection. We measure these documented interface combinations with five annotation fields linked to source evidence. The corpora comprise 517 solutions from 42 Kaggle competitions involving NLP and 76 participant systems from 26 SemEval, TREC, and WMT task years. Among eligible generation systems with decoder LLMs, 18 of 55 Kaggle systems and 17 of 20 Shared Task systems are hybrid: free generation coexists with a constrained interface. The remaining systems use free generation alone. Giving each competition or task year equal weight yields hybrid shares of 0.327 and 0.876. Within Eedi, 21 eligible systems with decoder LLMs have five exact interface profiles; ten LLM Science Exam systems share one interface class and have four profiles. Across Kaggle, the eligible systems with decoder LLMs span 18 exact interface profiles, revealing variation within broad tas

translated_title: 超越自由形式生成：测量竞赛级NLP系统中的接口组合
translated_abstract: 配备解码器大语言模型（LLM）的系统可以将自由生成与评分、排序或选择等操作相结合。我们使用与源证据相关联的五个标注字段来测量这些有据可查的接口组合。语料库包含来自42个涉及NLP的Kaggle竞赛的517个解决方案，以及来自26个SemEval、TREC和WMT任务年度的76个参赛系统。在符合条件的配备解码器LLM的生成系统中，55个Kaggle系统中有18个、20个共享任务系统中有17个属于混合型系统：自由生成与受限接口共存，其余系统则仅使用自由生成。当每个竞赛或任务年度被赋予相同权重时，混合型系统的占比分别为0.327和0.876。在Eedi竞赛中，21个符合条件的配备解码器LLM的系统呈现五种精确的接口配置；十个LLM Science Exam系统共享一个接口类别并呈现四种配置。在整个Kaggle范围内，符合条件的配备解码器LLM的系统跨越18种精确的接口配置，揭示了广泛任务类型内部的多样性。
tldr: 该研究通过对Kaggle和共享任务中数百个竞赛NLP系统的标注分析，首次量化了混合型系统（自由生成与受限接口结合）的占比差异，并识别出多种精细的接口配置模式。
en_tdlr: This study provides the first annotation-based quantification of interface composition in competitive NLP systems, revealing that hybrid systems combining free-form generation with constrained interfaces vary substantially across competitions and span 18 distinct interface profiles.
